result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a loading indicator is shown over a restaurant image card, making the content look unfinished or stuck loading.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image area shows a prominent loading spinner overlay instead of the final image, which makes the card look broken or still loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image finishes loading correctly; if loading is expected, use a smaller skeleton/placeholder that does not obscure the card image so prominently.
